faqs.title: Is Sideline Hero free?
body: Sideline Hero is free to download and use. The free version shows ads. An optional Premium purchase (an annual subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase) removes ads and adds new premium features as they're released.

faqs.title: Which devices does it run on?
body: iPhone and Android. There's no separate iPad version, but the iPhone app can be installed on an iPad.

faqs.title: Does my team data leave my phone?
body: Your team, player and game data stays on your phone and is never uploaded. The free version does use the internet to show ads (Google AdMob) and to check Premium purchases (RevenueCat), but those never receive your team data. Setting up and running a game works offline. Your data only leaves the phone if you share a game summary or export a file yourself, or if your phone's own backup includes app data.
The privacy policy has the details.

faqs.title: Do I need an account?
body: No. There's no sign-up, no login and no password.

faqs.title: Can I move my data to a new phone?
body: Only through your phone's own backup. If your iCloud or Google backup includes app data, restoring it on the new phone brings your teams and games across. There's no transfer inside the app.
